SELECT DISTINCT r."id",
                r."name",
                r."address",
                r."food_service"
FROM "restaurants" r
WHERE LOWER(r."cuisine") = 'italian';
108:
WITH hospital_role_counts AS (
    SELECT
        "roleid",
        COUNT(DISTINCT "hospitalid") AS hospital_count
    FROM
        "hospitals_medical_roles"
    GROUP BY
        "roleid"
),
total_hospitals AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS total_count
    FROM
        "hospitals"
)
SELECT
    m."rolename",
    m."salary"
FROM
    "medicalroles" m
JOIN
    "hospital_role_counts" hrc ON m."roleid" = hrc."roleid"
CROSS JOIN
    "total_hospitals" th
WHERE
    hrc.hospital_count = th.total_count;

SELECT
    j."minimum_years" AS min_experience_years,
    j."preferred_years" AS preferred_experience_years
FROM
    "jobs" j
WHERE
    j."salary" = (SELECT MAX("salary") FROM "jobs");
